messages:
jamie: Heads up — Maya's birthday this Friday (3/27). Want to do cake in the kitchen at 3:30? RSVP here :cake:
alex: Yes please :raised_hands:
mira: Can we do gluten-free? Maya's allergic to wheat.
jamie: Good catch — gluten-free cake ordered if majority ok. @kendall can you confirm budget?
kendall: Yep, go for it. I'll cover up to $40. Also happy to pick up.
people-ops-bot: Event created: Maya's Birthday — Friday 3/27 3:30 PM in Kitchen. RSVP: https://calendar.internal/evt/1752000000
sam: Can we also grab a small e-card? I can handle contributions. Venmo @sam-pay
alex: Count me in for $10.
mira: I'll bring sparkling water and cups.
jamie: Thanks all. Final headcount: 8? @mira can you confirm GF cake from supplier? also @kendall what's the plan if more than $40?
kendall: If >$40, we split. I'll create a quick thread in #random for contributions.
jamie: Perfect :tada: See you Friday!
